# NotebookLM in Action: 7 Killer Use Cases for Agencies

By [Cathy McPhillips](https://www.marketingaiinstitute.com/blog/author/cathy-mcphillips) on January 21, 2026

![Featured Image](https://www.marketingaiinstitute.com/hubfs/AI%20for%20Agencies%20Summit%202026%20-%20Goldcast.png)

[Intro To AI Free Class - Register Now](https://cta-service-cms2.hubspot.com/web-interactives/public/v1/track/click?encryptedPayload=AVxigLLE3HEV8ZRmmh%2BH%2FMojNHz22fCCNLlBwvu%2Ben7Jec1iI9dJ2amfEjCX2YqGR7%2FnUlN0Tcw29eiNVF41f2Mp8RFWHEk9jW3HfAeikFHwWAn7Ose3fh8qa6wWJB3D425ZQLYoO%2BvQBzc9e6unQzXikmY6UM5hs9fL8eUZQKgK6X37esVBQrg2vxOj5wUMe%2BJzFvmP&portalId=20757840)

If you lead or work inside an agency, you feel the relentless pace of AI innovation.

A new model, a new feature, a new promise to “change everything.” And while some of these tools are genuinely impressive, many agencies are struggling to answer a simple question:

How do we actually use AI in ways that improve the work we do for clients without sacrificing quality, trust, or context?

That’s where Google’s NotebookLM comes in.

Quietly, without much fanfare, NotebookLM is solving one of the biggest challenges agencies face with generative AI: working with their own information accurately, reliably, and quickly.

## The Real Problem With Most AI Tools in Agency Work

Most generative AI tools are trained on large volumes of publicly available data. That’s powerful, but it also creates headaches for agencies.

You’ve probably experienced it:

*   Outputs that sound confident but aren’t grounded in client reality
*   Hallucinations that pull from vague, unverified internet knowledge
*   Generic responses that require heavy rewriting to be usable

For agencies, this isn’t just annoying. It’s risky.

Client work depends on:

*   Brand guidelines
*   Research and strategy docs
*   Transcripts, briefs, reports, and internal knowledge
*   Institutional knowledge that lives across teams

And most AI tools weren’t built to start there.

## What Makes NotebookLM Different (and Why Agencies Should Care)

Google’s NotebookLM flips the typical AI workflow on its head.

Instead of asking an AI to “figure it out” from the internet, NotebookLM lets you upload your own sources, and then works exclusively from that material.

Think:

*   Client documents
*   Research reports
*   Strategy decks
*   Interview transcripts
*   Brand guidelines
*   Internal playbooks

No random web data. No guessing. No filler.

Just fast, intelligent synthesis of the information that actually matters to you and your clients.

For agencies, that’s a big deal.

## From “Interesting Tool” to Immediate Agency Impact

In his session at the AI for Agencies Summit, Mike Kaput, Chief Content Officer at SmarterX and the Marketing AI Institute, will demonstrate how NotebookLM can be used in real agency workflows today.

Not hypotheticals. Not theory. But practical guidance.

Seven concrete use cases, including how agencies can use NotebookLM to:

*   Accelerate research across industries, clients, and markets
*   Synthesize complex information into usable insights faster
*   Support strategy development without losing context
*   Create internal knowledge hubs that teams can actually use
*   Onboard new hires in days instead of weeks
*   Create consistent, brand-aligned content in minutes
*   Supercharge your content offerings with accompanying videos and audio overviews

If your agency has ever struggled with information overload or spent hours trying to understand complex research or reports, this session will help.

## Why This Matters Now 

At SmarterX and Marketing AI Institute, we spend a lot of time talking with agency leaders about where AI is actually creating leverage.

One theme comes up again and again:

The agencies that win won’t be the ones using the flashiest tools. They’ll be the ones using AI to think better, faster, and more consistently.

When agencies remove friction to the work around them, they free up time and energy for higher-value work where they truly differentiate.

## What You’ll See in Mike’s Session

Mike’s session is designed to be immediately actionable.

You’ll see:

*   Live demos of NotebookLM in action
*   Practical workflows agencies can replicate
